segments.title: Kissinger Obituary and Liliana's Power Daddy Eulogy
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens with technical difficulties (missing transitions) before welcoming Liliana to discuss Henry Kissinger's death at 100; Liliana delivers a sexually charged, satirical tribute framing Kissinger as a 'power daddy' while reading The Intercept's investigation into his war crimes.

segments.title: Masturbation World Record Attempt and the Scottish System
segments.notes: Chet Manscape commandeers the broadcast to analyze Drake Hardy's claimed 10-hour-10-minute masturbation record, detailing mood-lighting protocols, partial-tumescence strategy, and an invented 'Scottish system' of competitive self-pleasure measurement.

segments.title: Obliterated Trailer, Pokemon Horizons, and TM Robot Thriller
segments.notes: Trent reviews the Netflix film Obliterated (dismissing critical pans), watches the Pokemon Horizons trailer, and reacts to a TM-starring robot-assistant thriller trailer while complaining about missing fire transitions.

segments.title: Kelce Brothers Debate Ends in 50/50 Poll Tie
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate Travis vs. Jason Kelce; a rushed multi-stream poll finishes 50/50 before either can argue, prompting accusations of a 'miscarriage of something' and a chaotic sign-off as Case departs for gameplay.

segments.title: Lethal Company Session with Fiona, Malco, Exterminator, and Kendelle
segments.notes: Case Blackwell joins Fiona and crew for an extended Lethal Company run across multiple moons (Assurance, Offense, Val), featuring quicksand deaths, turret ambushes, a giant forest keeper, and a final quota scrape after a catastrophic orbital strike wipes the squad.

lore_notes.fact: Claims a personal supplement regimen called 'cryptotine' (crypto-linked creatine) at two spoonfuls daily.
Reveals an uncle lived in his basement for an extended period watching Silence of the Lambs on repeat in the dark, leaving a persistent stench.
Broadcast transition system (scene transitions, fire transition) suffered a total failure at top of show, forcing 'smoke teleportation' manual cuts.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with a transition-less broadcast and Liliana's libidinal Kissinger obituary, followed by Chet's exhaustive breakdown of a masturbation world-record attempt complete with invented Scottish rules. Trent at the Movies reviewed Obliterated and a TM robot thriller before a multi-stream poll glitch deadlocked the Munch & Crum Kelce debate. The network then pivoted to a feature-length Lethal Company session where Case, Fiona, Malco, Exterminator, and Kendelle scraped a quota victory after a catastrophic orbital strike wiped the entire crew.
